{{Quote|Jacen and I are going to go down the beach and look for sea motes. Okay?”''<br />''"Okay. But don’t go out of sight. If you can’t see me, I can’t see you.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and Jaina Solo on Illafian Point's north beach|<ref name="SOL" />}}
'''Seamotes''' or '''sea motes''' were [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceans]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Rathalay]] who lived in the surf of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. Beach-goers young and old collected their shiny,<ref name="SOL" /> jewel-like shells.<ref name="CE" />

In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="VacayDate">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' dated the events of the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] vacation to twelve years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dated [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, the Solos' visit occurred during [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] took a brief vacation to the northern beaches of [[Illafian Point]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. An elderly visitor taught the Solo children to search for sea mote shells, but only [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] hunted for the crustaceans.<ref name="SOL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Seamotes appeared in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="SOL" /> The creatures were cut from the [[Shield of Lies (abridged audiobook)|abridged audiobook]] release.<ref name="Abridged">''[[Shield of Lies (abridged audiobook)]]''</ref>
